title: Cloud Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A concise, hands‑on plan to solidify cloud fundamentals, master core services, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for certification and job search. Follow each phase to gain practical skills and credible evidence of ability.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish a solid base in cloud concepts, security, and cost awareness.

milestones.title: Cloud Fundamentals Overview
milestones.outcome: Explain core cloud models, services, and provider differences.

tasks.title: Read AWS Overview Docs
tasks.description: Study the AWS Cloud Overview page on the official AWS documentation to grasp the shared responsibility model and service categories.

tasks.title: Watch GCP Fundamentals Video
tasks.description: View the free introductory video on Google Cloud’s official YouTube channel covering IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.

tasks.title: Compare Azure Pricing Page
tasks.description: Navigate Azure’s pricing calculator and note key cost components for compute and storage.

tasks.title: Summarize Key Differences
tasks.description: Write a 200‑word comparison of AWS, GCP, and Azure core services.

milestones.title: IAM and Security Basics
milestones.outcome: Configure basic identity, access controls, and security best practices.

tasks.title: Complete IAM Lab on AWS
tasks.description: Follow the free IAM tutorial in AWS docs to create users, groups, and policies.

tasks.title: Set Up GCP Service Account
tasks.description: Create a service account with least‑privilege roles using the GCP console tutorial.

tasks.title: Review Azure RBAC Guide
tasks.description: Read the Azure Role‑Based Access Control documentation and note role hierarchy.

tasks.title: Write Security Checklist
tasks.description: Draft a checklist of top three security settings for each provider.

milestones.title: Cost Management Foundations
milestones.outcome: Interpret cost reports and identify simple optimization levers.

tasks.title: Explore AWS Cost Explorer
tasks.description: Navigate the Cost Explorer console, filter by service, and export a CSV report.

tasks.title: Analyze GCP Billing Export
tasks.description: Enable billing export to BigQuery and run a sample query to find top spenders.

tasks.title: Read Azure Cost Management Docs
tasks.description: Study the Azure Cost Management documentation focusing on budgeting alerts.

tasks.title: Identify One Savings Opportunity
tasks.description: Based on the reports, propose a single cost‑saving action for a hypothetical workload.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Deepen expertise in networking, compute, storage, and advanced security.

milestones.title: Networking Essentials
milestones.outcome: Design VPC/VNet architectures with subnets, routing, and security groups.

tasks.title: Build a VPC in AWS
tasks.description: Use the AWS console to create a VPC with public and private subnets, an Internet gateway, and route tables.

tasks.title: Create a GCP VPC Network
tasks.description: Follow the GCP quickstart to set up a custom VPC with firewall rules.

tasks.title: Configure Azure NSG Rules
tasks.description: Set up a Network Security Group in Azure portal and attach it to a subnet.

tasks.title: Compare CIDR Planning Guides
tasks.description: Read the CIDR planning sections in each provider’s networking docs and note differences.

tasks.title: Reflect on Network Isolation
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how you would isolate a database tier in each cloud.

milestones.title: Compute and Storage Mastery
milestones.outcome: Provision, scale, and manage compute instances and storage services.

tasks.title: Launch EC2 Instance
tasks.description: Create an Amazon EC2 t3.micro instance, attach an EBS volume, and SSH in.

tasks.title: Deploy GCP Compute Engine VM
tasks.description: Spin up a small VM, configure a startup script, and attach a persistent disk.

tasks.title: Create Azure Blob Container
tasks.description: Set up a storage account and a Blob container via Azure portal, then upload a test file.

tasks.title: Set Up Auto‑Scaling Group
tasks.description: Configure an auto‑scaling group for the EC2 instance using the AWS console tutorial.

tasks.title: Read Provider Storage Docs
tasks.description: Skim the official storage service documentation for each cloud to note durability guarantees.

milestones.title: Advanced Security Practices
milestones.outcome: Implement encryption, logging, and compliance controls.

tasks.title: Enable AWS CloudTrail
tasks.description: Activate CloudTrail in all regions and verify logs are stored in S3.

tasks.title: Configure GCP Cloud Audit Logs
tasks.description: Turn on audit logging for a project and view logs in Cloud Logging.

tasks.title: Set Up Azure Monitor Alerts
tasks.description: Create an alert rule for a storage account metric using Azure Monitor.

tasks.title: Encrypt Data at Rest
tasks.description: Enable server‑side encryption for an S3 bucket and a GCP Cloud Storage bucket.

tasks.title: Reflect on Compliance Needs
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph on how GDPR influences your security setup.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end cloud solutions.

milestones.title: 3‑Tier Web Application
milestones.outcome: Deploy a fully functional web app with front‑end, app, and database tiers on a cloud provider.

tasks.title: Design Architecture Diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a diagram showing load balancer, web servers, app servers, and database in your chosen cloud.

tasks.title: Provision Infrastructure with IaC
tasks.description: Use Terraform (free) to codify the VPC, subnets, and instances; apply the plan.

tasks.title: Deploy Sample App
tasks.description: Push a simple Node.js app to the web tier and verify end‑to‑end connectivity.

tasks.title: Configure Monitoring
tasks.description: Set up CloudWatch (or equivalent) dashboards for CPU and latency metrics.

tasks.title: Document Project on GitHub
tasks.description: Write a README that explains the architecture, steps to run, and lessons learned.

milestones.title: Cost‑Optimised Architecture Write‑up
milestones.outcome: Produce a detailed analysis showing how to reduce spend for a given workload.

tasks.title: Select a Sample Workload
tasks.description: Choose a common scenario (e.g., data processing pipeline) and outline its resources.

tasks.title: Identify Cost Drivers
tasks.description: Use the provider’s pricing calculator to list the top three cost contributors.

tasks.title: Propose Optimization Strategies
tasks.description: Write three concrete changes (e.g., reserved instances, right‑sizing) with expected savings.

tasks.title: Create Cost Comparison Sheet
tasks.description: Build a spreadsheet comparing current vs. optimized monthly costs.

tasks.title: Publish Write‑up Blog Post
tasks.description: Post the analysis on a personal blog or Medium with screenshots.

milestones.title: Associate‑Level Certification Prep
milestones.outcome: Pass an AWS, GCP, or Azure associate certification exam.

tasks.title: Enroll in Free Exam Guide
tasks.description: Download the official associate exam guide from the provider’s certification site.

tasks.title: Complete Practice Quiz
tasks.description: Take a free practice test on the provider’s training portal and note weak areas.

tasks.title: Review Exam Domains
tasks.description: Read the exam domain breakdown and map each to your existing knowledge gaps.

tasks.title: Do a Timed Mock Exam
tasks.description: Simulate exam conditions with a 90‑minute practice exam from free resources.

tasks.title: Plan Final Study Schedule
tasks.description: Create a 2‑week study plan focusing on remaining gaps before the exam date.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, earn certifications, and launch your job search or freelance career.

milestones.title: Advanced Topics Deep Dive
milestones.outcome: Apply serverless, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines in real scenarios.

tasks.title: Deploy a Serverless Function
tasks.description: Create a Lambda (or Cloud Function) that processes S3 events using the provider’s console tutorial.

tasks.title: Set Up Kubernetes Cluster
tasks.description: Provision an EKS (or GKE/AKS) cluster and deploy a sample nginx workload.

tasks.title: Configure CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Use GitHub Actions (free) to automatically build and deploy the sample app to the cloud.

tasks.title: Read Provider Advanced Docs
tasks.description: Skim the official serverless and container sections for best practices.

tasks.title: Reflect on Trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a brief note comparing serverless vs. containers for a given use case.

milestones.title: Certification Completion
milestones.outcome: Earn an associate‑level cloud certification and add it to your profile.

tasks.title: Schedule Exam Slot
tasks.description: Book a testing appointment on the provider’s certification portal.

tasks.title: Review Flashcards
tasks.description: Use free flashcard sets on Quizlet to reinforce key concepts for 30 minutes.

tasks.title: Take Final Exam
tasks.description: Complete the official associate certification exam.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn Badge
tasks.description: Add the new certification badge to your LinkedIn profile and resume.

tasks.title: Share Achievement Post
tasks.description: Write a short post announcing your certification on professional networks.

milestones.title: Job/Client Readiness
milestones.outcome: Present your portfolio, network, and interview confidently for cloud engineering roles.

tasks.title: Polish Portfolio Website
tasks.description: Create a simple static site showcasing the three projects with screenshots and links.

tasks.title: Craft Targeted Resume
tasks.description: Tailor your resume to highlight cloud skills, certifications, and project outcomes.

tasks.title: Practice System Design Interview
tasks.description: Do a mock design of a scalable web service with a peer or using online resources.

tasks.title: Attend Cloud Meet‑up
tasks.description: Join a local or virtual cloud engineering meetup and introduce yourself.

tasks.title: Reflect on Interview Feedback
tasks.description: After each mock or real interview, note strengths and improvement areas.
